source_boundary_limitations: English main v1.2 prose controls, supplemented by the supplied English glossary, FAQ and separately published Icon Overview. No Marine Worlds, promo, map-pack or strategy-guide rule was introduced.

Main PDF page 20 and solo-specific text/blue replacement effects were inspected to classify scope, but optional solo procedures were excluded. The printed option allowing multiplayer groups to substitute solo interactive effects is in-scope and appears in the candidate.

No standalone complete zoo-map/card asset set was supplied. The advanced-map section is a clarification reference to the supplied glossary/FAQ, not a reconstruction of unsupplied complete map abilities. In particular, absence of Map 3 details is not a missed printed procedure in this packet.

The Aquatic card middle requirement is concealed by a yellow player token in the supplied main-page-15 illustration. Its middle reward is visible, but the hidden requirement cannot independently be established. The candidate explicitly directs readers to the physical card rather than inventing that number.

Other hidden or illegible individual card requirements, full card catalogs, complete Final Scoring tables not shown in the packet, and full map text beyond the printed excerpts were not inferred. General card-text priority and procedures govern them.

The publisher photos contain German original components. Their numeric action-table/board cells supplement matching English diagrams narrowly; German prose is not an alternative rules edition for this audit.
